title: Product Design Intern
matchReason: Your Figma, UI design, and prototyping skills align with this role.
headline: Make software feel effortless.
description: Linear helps teams build better products. Join our design team to shape thoughtful experiences used by ambitious product teams around the world. You’ll learn by doing, with mentorship every step of the way.

title: Frontend Developer
matchReason: Strong alignment with your React and modern JavaScript portfolio.
headline: Powering financial experiences for millions.
description: Razorpay is building the financial backbone of internet businesses. We are looking for energetic frontend developers ready to build high-scale, accessible web apps.

title: UX Research Intern
matchReason: High overlap in user research and synthesis methodology.
headline: Help millions organize their work and life.
description: Work with our insights team to discover workflows and friction points for students and early-career makers adopting Notion as their primary productivity space.

title: Associate Product Designer
matchReason: Exceptional craft alignment in design systems and interactive prototyping.
headline: Empowering makers to design the future.
description: Help build tools that turn ideas into software. You will collaborate closely with engineering, research, and product management to shape intuitive experiences.

title: Backend Engineer (Node.js)
matchReason: Matches strong backend APIs and PostgreSQL competencies.
headline: Increasing the GDP of the internet.
description: Join Stripe backend infrastructure engineering to build dependable payment processing APIs, scalable webhooks, and real-time ledger verification systems.

title: Full Stack Developer Intern
matchReason: Exceptional fit for React 19, Next.js, and modern full-stack workflows.
headline: Make the web faster and more creative.
description: Build developer-focused interfaces and edge serverless integrations for next-generation web applications. Learn directly from framework authors and web architects.

title: Product Operations Intern
matchReason: Aligns with your analytical problem solving and customer research background.
headline: Delivering exceptional rewards and commerce.
description: Collaborate with product designers and operations leads to optimize member onboarding, transaction issue resolution, and reward partner workflows.

title: Mobile App Developer (React Native)
matchReason: Solid match for cross-platform app engineering and performant mobile animations.
headline: Delivering convenience at unprecedented scale.
description: Work on Swiggy main consumer app used by over 50 million monthly active diners and shoppers. Optimize bundle size, 60fps checkout transitions, and live order tracking.

title: Data Analyst Intern
matchReason: Matches structured SQL querying, data cleaning, and visualization expertise.
headline: Simplifying investing for 12+ million Indians.
description: Dig deep into trading behavior datasets to find friction points and produce actionable visualizations for product managers and compliance leaders.

title: Junior DevOps Engineer
matchReason: Strong alignment with automated deployment pipelines and container technologies.
headline: Building the global API platform.
description: Ensure high availability of our cloud runners and CI/CD pipelines. Automate Terraform scripts, manage Kubernetes pods, and build monitoring dashboards.

title: Design Systems Intern
matchReason: Flawless synergy with design token architecture and accessible UI component design.
headline: Belong anywhere.
description: Collaborate with our core systems guild to maintain Figma component libraries, verify WCAG AAA color contrast compliance, and craft documentation for hundreds of designers.

title: Machine Learning Intern
matchReason: Strong alignment with semantic search, vector embeddings, and LLM fine-tuning.
headline: Unleash the potential of every team.
description: Explore RAG architectures and automated ticket clustering algorithms within Jira and Confluence to help teams resolve blockers faster.

title: Content & Community Intern
matchReason: Solid communication, social media moderation, and template design background.
headline: Empower student campus ambassadors across India.
description: Host campus workshops, curate student study templates, and engage with our Discord community to introduce Notion to first-year university cohorts.

title: QA Automation Engineer
matchReason: Strong knowledge of end-to-end web testing and JavaScript test harnesses.
headline: Ensuring zero defects on critical financial rails.
description: Write robust Cypress and Playwright integration tests across checkout modals, payment gateway redirects, and subscription webhooks.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst Intern
matchReason: Strong fundamentals in network analysis, threat modeling, and Linux administration.
headline: Protecting the financial identities of high-trust individuals.
description: Assist our info-sec team in conducting vulnerability scans, reviewing IAM roles, and triaging suspicious intrusion alerts on production VPC networks.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Intern
matchReason: Solid grounding in DNS, CDN edge caching, and serverless compute primitives.
headline: Powering frontend cloud deployments worldwide.
description: Help build telemetry monitors and auto-scaling rules for serverless edge functions handling millions of requests every minute.
